content.title: About
content.content: Butter‑flavored microwave popcorn is a ready‑to‑cook bag containing corn kernels, butter seasoning, and oil. When heated in a microwave, the kernels pop into a light, crunchy, and aromatic snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Popcorn is one of the oldest snacks, enjoyed by ancient American civilizations.
Microwave popcorn was introduced in the 1980s and quickly became popular for its convenience.
The butter flavor is usually created with a blend of natural and artificial flavorings plus a small amount of oil.
One bag typically yields 2‑3 servings, perfect for movie nights.
Popcorn is gluten‑free, making it suitable for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Low in calories when eaten plain
items.content: Popcorn contains little fat and calories as long as extra butter, oil, or sugar are not added.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Corn kernels are rich in fiber, which supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Popcorn provides polyphenols that may help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Quickly prepared and gentle on the stomach, making it a convenient snack.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some varieties contain a lot of salt, which can be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Additives and flavorings
items.content: Artificial flavorings may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Risk of steam burns
items.content: Steam released from the bag after microwaving can cause burns, so open the bag carefully.

items.title: Calorie increase with toppings
items.content: Adding butter, cheese sauce, or caramel dramatically raises the calorie count.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Place the bag in the microwave and follow the instructions on the package (usually 2‑3 minutes on high). Let it sit for a minute after cooking, then open the bag, stir to distribute the butter flavor evenly, and enjoy.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened bag in a cool, dry place away from moisture. After opening, keep the popcorn in an airtight container to maintain crunchiness and prevent moisture absorption.
